method: Read-only public DOM inspection through CUA in connected Chrome
navigation: Direct query-free signin URL showed an error. Followed its Home link, then the public Hello, sign in Account & Lists link. No identifier entered or form submitted.
scope: Focused action and parent structure, not a new complete form specimen
finding: The existing specimen retains this action/IDREF/label structure and opacity. Missing aria-labelledby interpretation and the opacity threshold caused current adapter failures; a dropped value caption is not the cause for Amazon.
limitations: No editable or hidden field values, cookies, tokens, storage or network payloads were inspected.
This focused observation does not refresh the complete old form HTML/CSS or its source date.
The newly observed method is recorded here; no method was retroactively invented for the old specimen.
No production submission, registration or authentication was tested.
